scripts.gcp:login: gcloud auth login && gcloud config set project vigilant-broccoli && gcloud auth application-default login
scripts.gh:login: gh auth login && gh auth refresh -h github.com -s admin:org,delete_repo
scripts.tf:apply: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform apply && cd ../.. && ./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/post-apply.sh
scripts.code-server:password: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform state pull | jq -r '.resources[] | select(.type == "random_password" and .name == "code_server_password") | .instances[0].attributes.result' | pbcopy && echo 'Code server password copied to clipboard.'
scripts.code-server:replace: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform apply -replace=oci_core_instance.code_server && ssh-keygen -R $(terraform output -raw oci_code_server_public_ip) && ./scripts/sync-code-server-ip.sh
scripts.code-server:reset: ./scripts/shell/oci-ssh.sh oci_code_server_public_ip 'cd /opt/code-server && sudo docker compose down -v && sudo docker compose up -d'
scripts.seafile:password: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform state pull | jq -r '.resources[] | select(.type == "random_password" and .name == "seafile_admin_password") | .instances[0].attributes.result' | pbcopy && echo 'Seafile admin password copied to clipboard (login email: harryliu1995@gmail.com).'
scripts.seafile:replace: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform apply -replace=aws_instance.seafile && ssh-keygen -R $(terraform output -raw aws_seafile_public_ip)
scripts.seafile:reset: ./scripts/shell/oci-ssh.sh aws_seafile_public_ip 'cd /opt/seafile && sudo docker compose down -v && sudo docker compose up -d'
scripts.immich:replace: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform apply -replace=aws_instance.immich && ssh-keygen -R $(terraform output -raw aws_immich_public_ip)
scripts.immich:reset: ./scripts/shell/oci-ssh.sh aws_immich_public_ip 'cd /opt/immich && sudo docker compose down -v && sudo docker compose up -d'
scripts.grafana:password: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform state pull | jq -r '.resources[] | select(.type == "random_password" and .name == "grafana_admin_password") | .instances[0].attributes.result' | pbcopy && echo 'Grafana admin password copied to clipboard (login user: admin).'
scripts.rabbitmq:password: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform state pull | jq -r '.resources[] | select(.type == "random_password" and .name == "rabbitmq_password") | .instances[0].attributes.result' | pbcopy && echo 'RabbitMQ admin password copied to clipboard (login user: admin).'
scripts.grafana:replace: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform apply -replace=aws_instance.grafana && ssh-keygen -R $(terraform output -raw aws_grafana_public_ip)
scripts.grafana:reset: ./scripts/shell/oci-ssh.sh aws_grafana_public_ip 'cd /opt/observability && sudo docker compose down -v && sudo docker compose up -d'
scripts.logs:shipper:deploy: cd projects/nx-workspace && NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=./scripts/vault-ca.crt npx tsx scripts/fetch-secrets.ts --env-file deployment-configs/fly-configs/log-shipper.env.example --map FLY_LOG_SHIPPER_ACCESS_TOKEN:ACCESS_TOKEN --map LOKI_PUSH_PASSWORD:LOKI_PASSWORD './scripts/shell/deploy-log-shipper.sh'
scripts.gcp:vm:image:build: cd infrastructure/terraform/packer && make init && make build
scripts.gcp:vm:vault:test-local-connection: gcloud compute ssh vb-free-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap --command='export VAULT_ADDR=https://127.0.0.1:8200 VAULT_SKIP_VERIFY=true && vault status && echo "✓ Vault is accessible"'
scripts.secret-rotation:all: pnpm secret-rotation:flyio && pnpm secret-rotation:gitea && pnpm secret-rotation:profile-deploy-key && pnpm secret-rotation:tf-cloud && gh workflow run ci-rotate-secrets --repo iamharryliu/vigilant-broccoli && pnpm secret-rotation:oci
scripts.secret-rotation:calendar-sa: eval $(./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/load-vault-tf-env.sh) && cd infrastructure/terraform && terraform apply -replace=google_service_account_key.google_calendar_manager && cd ../.. && ./infrastructure/terraform/scripts/post-apply.sh && pnpm deploy:local-manager
scripts.local:install:machine-setup: if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ]; then zsh -c 'source setup/mac/install.sh'; else bash setup/linux/install.sh; fi
scripts.local:k3s:up: k3d cluster list vb-local >/dev/null 2>&1 || (k3d cluster create --config infrastructure/local/k3s/k3d-config.yaml && docker rm -f k3d-vb-local-tools >/dev/null)
scripts.local:k3s:status: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local get nodes -o wide && kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n local-platform get pods,ingress,pvc && kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n argocd get applications && helm --kube-context k3d-vb-local list -A
scripts.local:k3s:grafana:password: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n local-platform get secret grafana -o jsonpath='{.data.admin-password}' | base64 -d | pbcopy && echo 'Grafana admin password copied to clipboard (login user: admin).' && open https://grafana.vigilant-broccoli.app
scripts.local:k3s:headlamp:token: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n local-platform create token headlamp --duration=24h | pbcopy && echo 'Headlamp token (valid 24h) copied to clipboard.' && open https://headlamp.vigilant-broccoli.app
scripts.local:k3s:alloy:logs: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n local-platform logs -f deploy/alloy -c alloy
scripts.local:k3s:loki:logs: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n local-platform logs -f statefulset/loki -c loki
scripts.local:k3s:argocd:password: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n argocd get secret argocd-initial-admin-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d | pbcopy && echo 'Argo CD admin password copied to clipboard (login user: admin).' && open https://argocd.vigilant-broccoli.app
scripts.local:k3s:argocd:pause: kubectl --context k3d-vb-local -n argocd patch application local-platform --type merge -p '{"spec":{"syncPolicy":{"automated":null}}}'
scripts.immich:docker:reload: docker compose -f infrastructure/immich/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f infrastructure/immich/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.job-hunt:serve: cd projects/nx-workspace && CAREER_EXPERIENCE_PATH="$PWD/../../notes/personal/career/personal-software-career-experience.md" RESUME_PATH="$PWD/../../notes/personal/career/resume.json" JOB_APPLICATIONS_DIR="$HOME/Desktop/Job Applications" nx run job-hunt-next:serve
scripts.job-hunt:docker:up: bash -c '. ./infrastructure/agent-sandbox/load-env-from-vault.sh && cd projects/nx-workspace && nx run job-hunt-next:docker:up:repo-files'
scripts.agentic:dev-sandbox:reset: bash -c 'docker compose -f infrastructure/agent-sandbox/docker-compose.yml down -v && . ./infrastructure/agent-sandbox/load-env-from-vault.sh && docker compose -f infrastructure/agent-sandbox/docker-compose.yml up -d --build'
scripts.screenshot:setup: pnpm -C projects/nx-workspace exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.event-calendars:sync: cd projects/nx-workspace && env -u GITHUB_TOKEN VB_EXPRESS_URL=https://staging-vb-express.fly.dev NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=./scripts/vault-ca.crt tsx scripts/fetch-secrets.ts --env-file apps/ui/local-manager-next/.env.local.example --env-file scripts/.env.scripts.example 'tsx apps/ui/local-manager-next/scripts/sync-event-calendars.ts'
scripts.deploy:local-services: pnpm local:k3s:up && pnpm local:k3s:apply && pnpm deploy:local-manager
scripts.gh:actions:promote-production: gh workflow run manual-promote-production --repo iamharryliu/vigilant-broccoli --ref main
scripts.dockerhub:descriptions: cd projects/nx-workspace && env -u GITHUB_TOKEN NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=./scripts/vault-ca.crt tsx scripts/fetch-secrets.ts --env-file scripts/.env.dockerhub.example 'tsx scripts/update-dockerhub-descriptions.ts'
